about: Summit path: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for one coding agent at 25+ tok/s decode. Per-agent and aggregate are decode tok/s for one request; TTFT is warm, on the prompt each node's label names (4,096 tokens on droopy, 11,569 on snoopy). The CED nodes ran CPU only with the engram tables on NVMe (about 1 tok/s): a measurement condition for the prefill lever, not a serving layout.
